Stove Top Stuffing Chicken Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 12:10am

Ingredients




Chicken (white)
Celery tops
2 bay leaves
1 pt. sour cream
1 can cream of mushroom soup
1 med. onion
1/4 pound butter
1 cup chicken stock
1 (8 oz.) box Stove Top stuffing

Preparation

1 Boil chicken with celery tops, onion, and bay leaves. Cover and cook 20 minutes or until tender. Cool; take meat off bones and cut into bite size pieces. Mix 1 pint sour cream and 1 can cream of mushroom soup. Put in casserole dish. 2 Stove Top stuffing - melt 1/4 pound butter, 1 cup chicken stock, 8- ounce box stuffing. Put on top of chicken. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
